key_insight: SUPRA-Tex improves single-image 3D generation by separating texture estimation, surface alignment, and 3D completion, helping preserve fine details while producing relightable materials. This reduces artifacts from inconsistent multi-view predictions and makes the final 3D asset more faithful to the reference image.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the challenge of dressing a 3D mesh from one input image with realistic, relightable textures while preserving subtle visual details. Existing approaches often either create artifacts when combining multi-view predictions or lose detail when relying on implicit image-feature conditioning.
method: Decouple the pipeline into visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion.
Use super-aligned texture generation to better preserve high-frequency details from the reference image.
Integrate multi-view observations in a way that reduces conflicts and improves consistency across the textured 3D model.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this offers a more reliable path to high-fidelity 3D asset creation from a single image, especially for applications needing realistic materials and lighting. It can improve workflows in digital content creation, AR/VR, and asset generation where detail preservation and editability matter.
